works.body:
Hello!

I really love your style!  I would like you to draw my 2 original characters.

-The character with the darker skin and wavy hair is 178 cm. He's a scientists' assistant who helps his boss with his daily life.  He is very cheerful and easygoing but can get worried easily. 

-The character with messy black hair and glasses is 148 cm.
A mad scientist who saved his assistant's life with his medicines and surgeries. He is very intelligent but eccentric. Sometimes his experiments can be messy but he always manages to keep his assistant alive.

Their relationship is not normal. Please draw what comes to mind! Thank you.

Usage:
-Print, physical media for personal use
-Reference for future commission art

Please send high resolution PSD data if possible.
